t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There will be different gnomes of different colours and sizes of hats. Initially go for the little hats pink brown and beige. Then blue yellow and green hats. After that randomly guess

vb_textbox.text: There doesn't seem to be any consistent pattern throughout the game from what I could make out. I tried alternating the sides and then trying to look for a pattern. There are 6 colours and tall and short hats - They seem to give the same result for a while, then it seems like it changes. If you get a good result on one colour each time it comes up, choose it. Same with the hats (but be prepared that I feels like the rule changes). I was also looking out for the darkest colour of the two choices given which seemed to work later on in the game - then it seemed to swap to the lightest. Best advice I could give is try to work out the pattern that is happening - you will get some wrong, but try your best.
